hop_spring.name: Hop Spring
hop_spring.description: A tiny mechanical frog with a single wind-up key on its back. Its compression spring is visible through a small window in its brass body.
hop_spring.discoveryText: A common starter creature found in the Gear Garden. Wind it up and watch it hop!

leap_coil.name: Leap Coil
leap_coil.description: Added leg springs and a streamlined body make this creature incredibly nimble. Its chrome finish gleams as it bounds.
leap_coil.discoveryText: Chrome-plated and aerodynamic. This mechanical jumper can clear incredible heights!

spring_tank.name: Spring Tank
spring_tank.description: Thicker springs and armored plating make this creature a powerhouse. Slow but devastating.
spring_tank.discoveryText: Heavily armored with bronze plating. This tank can take a beating and dish one out!

rocket_hopper.name: Rocket Hopper
rocket_hopper.description: Sleek and aerodynamic with multiple coiled springs in its legs. Leaves a trail of sparks when it moves.
rocket_hopper.discoveryText: The fastest of the Spring series. Blink and you'll miss it!

bastion_toad.name: Bastion Toad
bastion_toad.description: Massive coil springs and heavy armor plating. Multiple compression mechanisms give it tremendous power.
bastion_toad.discoveryText: An immovable object. This fortress can withstand any assault!

vault_frog_speed.name: Vault Frog
vault_frog_speed.description: Chrome variant. Calculating trajectory gears visible in its glass dome head. Balanced springs allow precise movements.
vault_frog_speed.discoveryText: A tactical genius that calculates every jump with precision.

vault_frog_strength.name: Vault Frog
vault_frog_strength.description: Bronze variant. Calculating trajectory gears visible in its glass dome head. Balanced springs allow powerful movements.
vault_frog_strength.discoveryText: A tactical genius that calculates every jump with devastating force.

champion_silver_streak.name: Champion Mk.V 'Silver Streak'
champion_silver_streak.description: A sleek mechanical raptor/greyhound hybrid. Visible flywheel stores momentum. The pinnacle of speed engineering.
champion_silver_streak.discoveryText: The legendary Silver Streak. None can match its velocity!

champion_iron_guard.name: Champion Mk.V 'Iron Guard'
champion_iron_guard.description: Same Champion Mk.V frame, but built for defense. Bulkier armor plating and reinforced springs.
champion_iron_guard.discoveryText: The legendary Iron Guard. An unbreakable fortress of brass and determination!

scholar_wise_spring.name: Scholar Mk.III 'Wise Spring'
scholar_wise_spring.description: Mechanical owl/frog hybrid with intricate calculation gears in a glass dome head. Master of strategy.
scholar_wise_spring.discoveryText: The legendary Wise Spring. Its intellect is unmatched in the Clockwork Menagerie!
